findings.message: Gateway "Gateway_approved" has 2 outgoing flows but no default flow set.
findings.suggestion: Set a default flow to handle unmatched conditions.

findings.message: Exclusive gateway "Approved?" has no default sequence flow.
findings.suggestion: Add a default flow to ensure the process does not get stuck when no condition matches.

findings.message: Call activity "Book invoice" has no error boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add an error boundary event to handle errors propagated from the called process.

findings.message: User task "Approve invoice" has no timer boundary event.
findings.suggestion: Add a timer boundary to enforce an SLA and prevent tasks from waiting indefinitely.

findings.message: "Classify invoice" (businessRuleTask) has neither a zeebe:taskDefinition type nor a zeebe:calledDecision.
findings.suggestion: Set a decisionId or a job type.
Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: Call activity "Book invoice" has no zeebe:calledElement processId.
findings.suggestion: Set the process id to call.

fixes.description: Set default flow to "Flow_no" on gateway "Gateway_approved"
